info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/krea-2/turbo/lora
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/krea-2/turbo/lora queue.

x-fal-metadata.about: Generate an image with the distilled Krea 2 turbo checkpoint and LoRA weights.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible generation. Image *i* uses `seed + i`.
seed.title: Seed

image_size.description: The size of the generated image.
image_size.title: Image Size

acceleration.description: The acceleration level to use for the image generation.
acceleration.title: Acceleration

examples: a vintage travel poster for Mars
prompt.description: Base text description of the image to generate.
prompt.title: Prompt

loras.description: List of LoRA weights to apply (maximum 3).
loras.title: Loras

num_images.description: The number of images to generate.
num_images.title: Number of Images

enable_safety_checker.description: If true, the output safety checker is enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked, and images flagged as unsafe are returned as black images.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

enable_prompt_expansion.description: If true, the prompt is expanded with an LLM into a more detailed image-generation prompt for higher quality results. On failure, the original prompt is used unchanged.
enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion

output_format.description: The format of the generated image. Default value: "png".
output_format.title: Output Format

has_nsfw_concepts.description: Whether each generated image contains NSFW concepts.
has_nsfw_concepts.title: Has Nsfw Concepts

seed.description: The seed used to generate the image(s).
seed.title: Seed

actual_prompt.description: The final prompt after expansion, if prompt expansion was enabled.
actual_prompt.title: Actual Prompt

timings.description: Timing information for the request, in seconds.
timings.title: Timings

width.description: The width of the generated image.
width.title: Width

height.description: The height of the generated image.
height.title: Height

scale.description: Scale factor for LoRA application (0.0 to 4.0).
scale.title: Scale

path.description: URL, HuggingFace repo ID (owner/repo), or local path to LoRA weights.
path.title: Path

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
